text:
Asha M.: Quick flag while building Friday KPI slide deck — launch-post traffic spike on Wed but demo conversions look noisy for that cohort. Can someone sanity-check sample sizes?
Tom R.: Yup, I see that. Impressions up 3x but demo events are flat. The 95% CI on the cohort CR is huge given we only have ~120 users.
Priyanka (demand): That small-n issue will make the headline rate volatile. Can you share the sample counts per day?
Tom R.: Day-level: Wed 78 users, Thu 22, Fri 20. If we aggregate weekly it's marginally better but still low.
Devon (growth): Also worth checking whether the dashboard is using a sampled dataset for the viz. We had sampling on the live viz during heavy queries last month.
Asha M.: Ops-bot: "ops-bot: dataset-status OK. latest ETL id: 20260421-3"
Tom R.: Quick check: the viz layer pulls from the materialized summary table (no sampling) but the raw query used for the ad-hoc slide was hitting a sampled export. I will swap to the summary table and re-run.
Priyanka (demand): Good. Also let's show a small margin-of-error line on the KPI slide so leadership understands uncertainty.
Devon (growth): Agreed. Hypothesis: creative change on Wed amplified top-funnel but the cohort is too small to conclude demo conversion loss. We should hold on knee-jerk spend changes until we confirm.
Asha M.: Can we include both the raw rate and a 95% CI band + a note about sample size in the slide? Also add webinar cohort for comparison — webinar traffic has larger n and narrower CI.
Tom R.: Will update the slide: (1) swap to summary table source; (2) add CI ribbons; (3) include a small table with daily n and pooled n. ETA 2pm PT.
Priyanka (demand): I'll pull creative variants and tag which posts used the new CTA so we can correlate.
Devon (growth): I'll hold off on the paid boost until the CI is confirmed. If the CI excludes a meaningful drop we can act.
ops-bot: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am  invite posted to #marketing"
Asha M.: Perfect — thanks. We'll present the slide with uncertainty callouts and a recommendation to monitor 72h after Tom's update. :white_check_mark:
